plain: To hand over to someone's care or control

webster.text: To give, send or set over; to transfer or deliver into the possession of another, or into a different state, with the sense of fixedness in that state, or permanence of possession.

example.quote: The mode of conducting it after it is declared, it consigns to the executive department.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
